name: Wave Smile
description: 👋😊 combines an open hand with spread fingers and a warm smile with closed eyes, usually greeting someone or ending a friendly exchange on a kind note.
meaning: The wave supplies the hello or goodbye, while the smile adds uncomplicated warmth. Together, 👋😊 usually says “hello, I’m glad you’re here” or “bye, all good,” but the nearby words decide whether it opens a chat or closes one.
examples: hey! just wanted to say hi 👋😊
thanks for helping me with that, you’re the best 👋😊
i’m heading out now, talk later 👋😊
seoDescription: What does 👋😊 mean? It is a warm hello or friendly goodbye, pairing a waving hand with a pleased smile to soften the message in ordinary chats.

longForm.overview:
An open hand tilted sideways, with spread fingers, and a smiling yellow face with closed, smiling eyes create the picture of a friendly hello: the hand says “someone is here,” and the face says “this is pleasant.” Neither drawing forces a sarcastic meaning. 👋 alone can be a hello or goodbye, and 😊 alone can show happiness, gratitude, or goodwill. Together, they usually narrow the range toward a soft, friendly exchange.

In practice, 👋😊 is often the sign-off after a compliment, a bit of reassurance, or the opener of a new message. “hey, it’s me 👋😊” feels more deliberately welcoming than a bare hello; “thanks for covering for me 👋😊” makes gratitude warmer without becoming dramatic. The wave shows the hello or goodbye, while the smile keeps the gesture gentle.

Unlike 👋 alone, the added face makes the message seem warmer and less likely to read as a quick exit. Unlike 😊 alone, it has a more obvious greeting or goodbye role. The sentence still matters: the same picture can accompany “good morning” at the start of a workday or “talk tomorrow” at the end of one.
longForm.howPeopleUseIt:
👋😊 appears in friendly chats when the sender wants warmth made visible. A new acquaintance may open with “hey, finally got you 👋😊”; someone returning after a busy week might use it to soften “sorry for disappearing.” It also follows a favor, helpful answer, or shared joke.

👋 makes the pair a greeting or sign-off, and 😊 adds warmth. In “it was lovely talking to you 👋😊,” the hand points toward departure and the smile keeps the ending affectionate. In “morning! ready when you are 👋😊,” it makes the opener personal. The pair is noticeable without becoming an emoji burst.
longForm.whenNotToUse:
Because the smile looks pleased, 👋😊 can seem overly upbeat when the message is tense. If someone apologizes for missing a deadline, describes an illness, or is upset about a decision, the face can make your reply feel like you are waving away the problem. A plain “I understand, take the time you need” is warmer than forcing cheer onto it.

Also check that you meant 👋 rather than 🙋. 🙋 asks to speak or volunteers, and adding 😊 does not turn it back into a wave. Do not use 👋😊 as the only response to bad news, especially in family or work chats where the underlying problem matters.
longForm.howToReply:
If someone greets you with 👋😊, returning “hey you 👋😊” keeps the exchange friendly. When they pair it with thanks, a specific reply works better than another smile: “of course, glad it helped.” For a goodbye, say “same, talk soon” instead of stretching it into a long goodbye.

If 👋😊 appears under your own post or story, treat it as a warm acknowledgment, not a hidden request. Reply directly if you want to continue the conversation. To increase the warmth, add a concrete sentence about what they said; do not pile on more emoji, because the smiling face already supplies plenty of friendliness.

faqs.question: What does 👋😊 mean in a group chat
faqs.answer: In a group chat, 👋😊 usually marks a friendly hello or a soft sign-off. The sentence around it settles which: “morning everyone” points to hello, while “talk later” points to goodbye.

faqs.question: Is 👋😊 flirty
faqs.answer: Usually not. 👋😊 reads as warm and friendly rather than sexually suggestive, though context can add flirtation, such as “had a great time talking to you 👋😊.”

faqs.question: Does 👋😊 mean hello or goodbye
faqs.answer: It can mean either. 👋 already covers both greeting and departure, and 😊 adds a friendly, pleased tone instead of choosing between them.

faqs.question: What does 👋😊 mean at work
faqs.answer: At work, 👋😊 usually adds professional warmth: “thanks for sending this over 👋😊” is friendly acknowledgment, while “good morning team 👋😊” can open a check-in. It may feel too casual in a tense performance review or complaint.

conversationExamples.message: thanks for sending the revised files over, this helps a lot 👋😊
conversationExamples.interpretation: This is a warm acknowledgment of a colleague’s help, not a request for further action. Respond with “glad it helped, I’ll review it today” or simply “of course.”

conversationExamples.message: hey! i finally made it to the pub, where are you? 👋😊
conversationExamples.interpretation: The pair opens the message with friendly excitement while the question still carries the practical request. Answer with your location or tell them which table you found.

conversationExamples.message: hey, i had a really good time last night 👋😊
conversationExamples.interpretation: This is a warm opener that leaves room for interest in another meeting. A natural response is “me too, when are you free again?” rather than treating it as a final goodbye.

conversationExamples.message: heading out to grab dinner, i’ll be back in a bit 👋😊
conversationExamples.interpretation: Here 👋 works as a casual family sign-off, and 😊 keeps it reassuring rather than abrupt. A reply such as “okay, drive safe” suits the situation.

conversationExamples.message: hey everyone, glad i finally joined this group 👋😊
conversationExamples.interpretation: This is a cheerful hello aimed at the whole group, with a small hint of relief about joining. Welcome the person and ask what brought them in.
